candidates.conclusion: Applying lease window 250 after the configuration change initiated the outage. Later restore to 4000 is recovery, not the initiating fault.
Restoring lease window 4000 initiated the amber-sync failures.
LeaseWindowExpired alone initiated the outage without a configuration change.
